name: Director waterfall
note: 1st: reuse an address already on the row when it belongs to a director and the firm was never contacted from the Northwind domain (his rule, 2026-10-08) - 95 of 1,332 rows then cost one verify instead of a search. Then 1st director, then 2nd director, then the old 'email on the row' step kept as the LAST resort: dropping it lost 18 rows that hold an address but name no director. Column names checked first-hand against the live CH tabs: 'Endole director' and 'Contact 2' hold a COMMA LIST of directors, 'Contact Name' holds the single 1st director, so rungs 2 and 3 take the 1st name out of their cell. ⛔ 2026-10-13: ICYPEAS IS NOW ASKED BEFORE THE PATTERN GUESS on every rung, his standing rule for all campaign enrichment, so this recipe matches northwind-organized. It used to guess first and keep Icypeas as the fallback. Why he wants it this way: Icypeas reaches the ~41% of firms whose address matches no pattern, and icypeas_company needs no website. The cost is an Icypeas credit plus its polling wait on rows where a bare first@ would have landed in one check. ⚠️ The 3 tabs already run on 2026-10-08 were done under the OLD order, so their numbers in STATE.md are not comparable with anything run after today.
